title: Jobs and the Monday-night merry-go-round
summary: Picnics and dances, and a two-season Monday night job at Hickory and Eagle.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: About where did you play? What kind of jobs? I mean were they?
Single spot jobs all around? Yeah, all around. We had no particular place.

The longest place we played was up at. On the Hickory and Eagle, we used to call that place the merry-go-round. We used to play up there every Monday night. Yeah, we played up there about two seasons. Every Monday night.
